Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about XFree tools.

Are XFree tools really free?

Yes, 100% free with no hidden limits, no signup required, and no watermarks on outputs.

How do the tools work?

All tools execute entirely in your browser using JavaScript. No data is sent to external servers.

Is my data safe?

Absolutely. Your data never leaves your browser. Close the tab and all data is gone from memory.

Do I need to install anything?

No. All tools work directly in your browser. No desktop apps, browser extensions, or signups.

What browsers are supported?

All modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Brave. We recommend the latest version.

Can I use tools offline?

Once a tool page is loaded, most functionality works offline since everything runs client-side.

How often are tools updated?

Tools are regularly maintained and updated to follow latest web standards and browser policies.

Can I suggest a new tool?

Yes! Use the contact form to submit tool requests. We review all suggestions.

Still have questions?

Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
